+title: AG-8b AgentsTool conforms to GraphQLEndpointTool and gives AgentsGraph over its registry
+---
+## What
+`AgentsTool` conforms to `GraphQLEndpointTool` (EXTRAS-7, D75; EXTRAS-9 rule 1). Its `graphQLEndpoints` is a list of one: the `AgentsGraph` of AG-8a over the same `AgentRegistry` as `context.runner.registry`, so the model and a client see one catalog. The tool stays an `OperationTool<AgentsToolContext>` op tool: its name, description, schema and operations do not change, and the model sends no GraphQL text to it. A host finds the endpoint with `tool as? any GraphQLEndpointTool`.
+
+Decide and document what a `messagingOnly` tool gives: the endpoint reads the catalog, not the grant of the model, so give the endpoint for both grants (the host lists the endpoint of the session folder, not of one run). Make the endpoint once in `make(context:)`, not on each read of `graphQLEndpoints`.
+
+Update the README/DocC and the doc comment of `AgentsTool` to name the endpoint.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+- [ ] `AgentsTool: GraphQLEndpointTool`; `graphQLEndpoints` has one endpoint, name `agents`, version `1`, scope `sessionFolder`.
+- [ ] The endpoint and `list agents` read the same registry: a reload shows in both.
+- [ ] The model-facing tool definition (name, description, pinned schema) is unchanged.
+
+## Tests (EXTRAS-9 rule 11)
+- [ ] The tool gives the endpoint in `graphQLEndpoints` with its name, version and scope, for each grant.
+- [ ] A cast `any Tool as? any GraphQLEndpointTool` succeeds on a made `AgentsTool`.
+- [ ] After `registry.reload()` with a new agent folder, `agents` through the tool's endpoint lists it. #AG-8
\ No newline at end of file

AG-8c can add its ChangeLog to the port (or the state, next to the generation swap, so cursor and catalog read one generation).
+    - `AgentsTool.make` fetches the registry's one endpoint for both grants and stores it; `graphQLEndpoints` returns `[endpoint]`.
